defects.description: render_receipt prints the discount negated ('DISCOUNT -5001') instead of 'DISCOUNT <discount>' required by REQ-004/AC-004-2 and DESIGN-002 (G4 review finding F-1).
defects.root_cause: Implementation formatted the DISCOUNT line with -result['discount'] instead of result['discount']; unit tests only used discount 0 so it was not caught, TEST-013 would have failed.
